definition: Plug & Pray is a 2010 documentary film about the promise, problems and ethics of artificial intelligence and robotics.
details: The main protagonists are the former MIT professor Joseph Weizenbaum and the futurist Raymond Kurzweil. The title is a pun on the computer hardware phrase "Plug and Play".
story: Picture guardrails on a mountain road — not there to slow you down on the straightaways, but to keep you from flying off the cliff. It is the habit of asking, before every launch, what could go wrong — and then doing something about it. Think of it as the quiet rule that a tool should be useful without being dangerous. It is the difference between “it works” and “it is safe to put in front of people.” That deliberate caution is Plug & Pray.
